title: A Positive Case for Faithfulness: LLM Self-Explanations Help Predict Model Behavior
reasoning: The paper includes a significant component of evaluating Large Language Models on ethical datasets, most notably the 'Moral Machines' dataset. It examines how models reason through moral dilemmas (e.g., trolley problems), evaluates ethical principles like the 'action/inaction' principle, and uses the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) for evaluation.
